title: Installment Payment Plans: Endorsement Deposit by Installments Remaining
content:
On the **Installment Payment Plans**, the endorsement deposit taken on an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan is figured according to how many installments are still unbilled. The installments still unbilled are the plan's number of installments less the installment invoices already issued on the plan. The endorsement balance is the balance on which the deposit is taken.

**Ladder**

1. **At most one installment still unbilled, or an endorsement balance of 50.00 or less:** the deposit is figured as the whole endorsement balance.
2. **Two or three installments still unbilled, and an endorsement balance of more than 50.00:** the deposit is figured as one unbilled installment's share of the balance — the endorsement balance divided by the installments still unbilled, rounded half up to the cent.
3. **Four or more installments still unbilled, and an endorsement balance of more than 50.00:** the deposit is figured as 20 percent of the endorsement balance, rounded half up to the cent, not less than 25.00 and not more than the endorsement balance.

**Combinations (hypothetical balances)**

| Installments still unbilled | Endorsement balance | Deposit figured as |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 400.00 | 400.00 (whole balance) |
| 3 | 50.00 | 50.00 (whole balance: not more than 50.00) |
| 3 | 50.01 | 16.67 (50.01 divided by 3, rounded) |
| 2 | 310.00 | 155.00 |
| 4 | 310.00 | 62.00 (20 percent) |
| 5 | 60.00 | 25.00 (20 percent is 12.00, raised to 25.00) |
| 0 | 120.00 | 120.00 (whole balance) |

The count is read from the plan's own installment invoices.
